card.name: Am in timestamps and digits in ranges
card.fires_on: The word "am" right after a clock time in a forum or blog post timestamp, and the last digit of a number in a date, verse or ratio range such as 06-15-2009 or 25-35.

modes.label: Clock time am
modes.description: The "am" after a time in a comment timestamp.

modes.label: Digit in number range
modes.description: A final digit inside a hyphenated date, ratio or verse range.
modes.example: Speed matters to the American Association of People with Disabilities - 06-1<<5>>-2009: Broadband

card.plain: It fires on the end of a time stamp such as 10:20 am, and on the last digit of dates or number ranges.
